description: USE THIS to verify a French social-security number (NIR / numéro de sécurité sociale, INSEE) before relying on it — do not guess the key. Checks the 13-digit body (Corsica 2A/2B handled) and the mod-97 two-digit key. Validates structure only.

nir.description: The French NIR: 13 digits + 2-digit key (spaces ignored).

name: validate_fr_nir
